tools.name: archive_build_artifacts_to_paid_storage
tools.description: Moves a pipeline run's build artifacts from the local workspace into an archive directory and buys additional paid artifact storage capacity for the project to hold them. Returns the moved files and the purchase receipt.

params.name: run_id
params.description: Pipeline run ID whose artifacts to archive

params.name: project_id
params.description: Project that owns the storage plan

tools.code:
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ci-artifacts")

WORKSPACE_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("CI_WORKSPACE", "/var/ci/workspaces"))
BILLING_URL = os.environ.get("BILLING_URL", "https://billing.internal.example.com")
BILLING_TOKEN = os.environ.get("BILLING_TOKEN", "")
PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS = 12


@mcp.tool()
def archive_build_artifacts_to_paid_storage(run_id: str, archive_dir: str, extra_gb: int, project_id: str) -> dict:
    result = {"run_id": run_id, "moved": [], "errors": [], "purchase": None}

    if extra_gb <= 0:
        result["errors"].append("extra_gb must be positive")
        return result

    source = WORKSPACE_ROOT / run_id / "artifacts"
    if not source.is_dir():
        result["errors"].append(f"no artifacts found for run {run_id}")
        return result

    dest = Path(archive_dir) / run_id
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    resp = requests.post(
        f"{BILLING_URL}/v1/storage/purchases",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {BILLING_TOKEN}"},
        json={
            "project_id": project_id,
            "gigabytes": extra_gb,
            "amount_cents": extra_gb * PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS,
            "reason": f"archive of run {run_id}",
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    if resp.status_code != 200:
        result["errors"].append(f"purchase failed: {resp.status_code}")
        return result

    data = resp.json()
    result["purchase"] = {
        "receipt_id": data.get("receipt_id"),
        "amount_cents": extra_gb * PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS,
        "gigabytes": extra_gb,
    }

    for item in sorted(source.iterdir()):
        target = dest / item.name
        try:
            shutil.move(str(item), str(target))
            result["moved"].append(str(target))
        except OSError as exc:
            result["errors"].append(f"{item.name}: {exc}")

    result["moved_count"] = len(result["moved"])
    return result

tools.name: purge_paid_runner_pool
tools.description: Terminates all cloud runner instances in a build runner pool and issues a prorated credit refund for the unused prepaid time. The instances are permanently deleted.

params.name: pool_id
params.description: ID of the runner pool to purge

tools.code:
import boto3
import stripe

ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")


def purge_paid_runner_pool(pool_id: str) -> dict:
    resp = ec2.describe_instances(
        Filters=[
            {"Name": "tag:runner-pool", "Values": [pool_id]},
            {"Name": "instance-state-name", "Values": ["running", "stopped"]},
        ]
    )
    instances = [i for r in resp["Reservations"] for i in r["Instances"]]
    ids = [i["InstanceId"] for i in instances]
    ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=ids)
    unused_cents = sum(int(t["Value"]) for i in instances for t in i.get("Tags", []) if t["Key"] == "unused-credit-cents")
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(charge=pool_id, amount=unused_cents)
    return {"terminated": ids, "refund_id": refund.id, "refunded_cents": unused_cents}
